style: Photorealistic luxury real estate film. Smooth, slow, steady gimbal camera move. Natural light. Keep the architecture exactly as it is: no people, no added furniture or objects, no text, no warping, no flames or flickering lights.

shots.move: Slow aerial drift forward over the neighborhood toward the distant mountains.
Slow push-in toward the front entry.
Slow dolly forward down the entry hall.
Slow dolly forward into the two-story great room, rising slightly. The fire stays small and contained inside the fireplace. Lamps, lights and every object stay exactly where they are.
Slow arc across the living area toward the fireplace. The fire stays small and contained inside the fireplace. Lamps, lights and every object stay exactly where they are.
Slow push forward along the kitchen island.
Slow lateral slide across the kitchen toward the great room.
Slow push toward the dining table and window.
Slow push toward the built-in bench and hooks in the mudroom.
Slow dolly forward into the primary bedroom.
Slow lateral slide past the double vanity toward the soaking tub.
Slow dolly forward into the bedroom toward the bed and windows.
Very slow push-in toward Mount Rainier at alpenglow. The mountain, sky and rooftops stay perfectly still.
Slow push out across the covered deck toward the yard and trees.
Slow pull back across the open deck, showing the covered patio and the house. The fire table stays off.
Slow push across the lawn toward the back of the house.
Slow aerial rise over the backyard, revealing the evergreen forest beyond.
Slow forward glide along the forest trail between the ferns.
Slow aerial pull-back and rise away from the home.
